cause_quote: The new epoch check required `epoch.documentRevision === (tabRevisions.get(tabId)?.document ?? 0)` for document-scoped reads, so an allowed navigation could fail the check and trigger the existing `access was revoked` error while tab access was still current.
user_saw: When a page changed during a browser read, the error said access was revoked, so the agent could ask the user to grant permission again.
summary: The Chrome extension still rejects stale reads and now tells the agent to inspect the current page before retrying when tab access remains valid.
reasoning: The parent used one epoch for both tab access and document freshness, and #132232 introduced a separate document revision while keeping the shared revocation error. Document-only rejection therefore shipped with the misleading diagnostic. I checked that #167926 merely moved the existing error text into a lookup table.
